items.text: PostgreSQL 16 Schema (Full DDL): the database is PostgreSQL 16.
This is the consolidated database schema.
The multi-tenant `tenant_id`/`brand_id` column is a foreign key to `tenants.id`.
DDL section 1: Tenants / Brands (tenants table represents tenants/brands).
tenants.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
DDL section 2: Users / RBAC Roles (users table carries RBAC roles).
users.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
users.tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL
DDL section 3: Brand Chunks is the pgvector RAG Store.
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; (pgvector extension enabled).
brand_chunks.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
brand_chunks.brand_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL
brand_chunks.type values: tone_rule | glossary | compliance | example.
products.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
products.brand_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL
DDL section 5: Marketplace Accounts hold Encrypted Credentials.
marketplace_accounts.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
marketplace_accounts.brand_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL
listings.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
listings.product_id UUID REFERENCES products(id) NOT NULL
DDL section 7: Listing Versions provide Maker-Checker Integrity.
listing_versions.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
listing_versions.listing_id UUID REFERENCES listings(id) NOT NULL
Architectural Invariant: Creator cannot approve own listing.
listing_versions CHECK (approved_by_user_id IS NULL OR approved_by_user_id <> generated_by_user_id).
rules.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
validation_runs.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
validation_runs.listing_id UUID REFERENCES listings(id) NOT NULL
DDL section 10: Agent Runs provide Full AI Observability & Cost Tracking.
agent_runs.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
agent_runs.trigger values: generate | correct | embed | vision.
images.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
images.tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL
images.product_id UUID REFERENCES products(id) NOT NULL
DDL section 12: Performance holds Basic Post-Publish Metrics.
performance.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
performance.listing_id UUID REFERENCES listings(id) NOT NULL
DDL section 13: Audit Log is Append-Only.
audit_log.id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
Closing ``` code fence of the SQL DDL.

Length Boundaries: enforce strict character caps.

Every error returns this identical JSON shape (Unified ErrorReport).
Errors from rules return the identical ErrorReport JSON shape.
Errors from vision models return the identical ErrorReport JSON shape.
Errors from marketplace APIs return the identical ErrorReport JSON shape.
ErrorReport "errors": array of per-field error objects.
errors[]."message" (example "Title is 221 chars; Amazon maximum allowed is 200 chars").
errors[]."value_submitted" (example "Organic Cotton Kurta Set — Women's Ethnic Wear, Playful Premium Luxury Hand-Block Print...").
errors[]."suggestion" (example "Shorten title to <= 200 chars; move secondary features into bullet points").
Table header: Source | Example Error Codes | Retryable by AI? | Handling Strategy.
rules_engine errors: Retryable by AI? Yes.
rules_engine: Correction node regenerates only the failed field.
vision_model errors: Retryable by AI? Conditional.
vision_model: Deterministic issues prompt user for new asset.
vision_model: fixable issues route to repair.
amazon_adapter errors: Retryable by AI? No (Auth/Rate: Auto).
amazon_adapter: SKU conflicts require human operator resolution.
flipkart_adapter errors: Retryable by AI? Partial.
flipkart_adapter: Partial success retries only failed fields.

Table header: Agent | Input Data | Generated Output | Operational Notes.
Content Agent input: top-8 brand chunks.
Content Agent has the highest token expenditure.
Content Agent: structured JSON output mode enforced.
Keyword Agent output: backend search keywords.
Keyword Agent adheres to character limits.
Attribute Agent validates against target marketplace category requirements.
Image Agent output: Structured ImageReport per slot.
Image Agent runs deterministic pixel checks first.
Image Agent runs vision model analysis second.
Brand Voice Retrieval output: Top-k brand chunks (pgvector).
Brand Voice Retrieval is a pure retrieval component.
Brand Voice Retrieval feeds context to generation agents.
Risk addressed: silent LLM bill creep.
Model invocation follows a strict economic policy.
Cheapest Default Route: route text generation to the most cost-effective model meeting the quality bar.
Cheapest Default Route: route vision generation to the most cost-effective model meeting the quality bar.
Escalation trigger: structured JSON output validation fails twice on a run.
On repeated failure, escalate only that run to a stronger reasoning model tier.
Embeddings always use a lightweight text-embedding model.
Never use the generation model for embeddings.
Mandatory Telemetry: every single call logs `model_used` into `agent_runs`.
